notes: A cell is one telemetry line (one turn). Segments are split by |. Segment 1 is the turn; each further segment is one settlement record, in file order.
Inside a segment, sections are split by a space. A section is CODE:payload. CODE~ means that optional object is absent (St, X, Y) or that the array is empty (tables).
A section that is missing entirely = every field in it has its default (for a table with no default rows: an empty array).
Tuple payload: values split by , in the "pos" order below. An EMPTY value means the default. Trailing empty values are dropped.
Table payload: rows split by /, values inside a row split by ,. *N = N rows that are all defaults.
Numbers are the writer's exact text; a leading 0. is written as . (and -0. as -.). N = NaN, I = Infinity, -I = -Infinity. Bools: 1 true, 0 false.
Double arrays: values split by ; (~ = empty array).
Ledger legs (k table): reason[+sourceUnits][-sinkUnits] split by ; (missing units = 0; ~ = no legs). Each leg is one sources[] row and one sinks[] row with that reason.
!JSON = escape: the value is a JSON literal (used only when the codebook cannot express it; separators inside strings appear as \u escapes).
